page.layout: One column of text, centred heading above a numbered list of eight entries, left-aligned under it. No margin notes, running head, page number or catchword. Faint show-through from the reverse side (title lettering and imprint at upper and lower centre) is ignored.

main_text.head: INDEX MISCELLANEORUM Catecheticorum.
main_text.l: I. Praefationes D. Davidis Parei quatuor partibus explicationum catechet. priore editione prefixa.
II. Oratio exhortatoria D. Zacharia Vrsini ad studium doctrinae Christianae.
III. Symbolum Antiochenum de incarnatione Verbi, adversus Paulum Samosatenum: & catholica fides de Ubiquitate: ex Vigil. lib. 4. cont. Eut.
IV. Epistola D. Vrsini de praedestinatione: cum fragmentis aliquot epistolarum eiusdem.
V. Fragmentum orationis de quaestione: an & quatenus Christus sit mortuum pro omnibus: authore Davide Pareo.
VI. Isagoge brevissima Davidis Parei ad controversiam eucharisticam.
VII. Compendiosa explicatio totius de cæna Domini controversia inter Synusiastas & Orthodoxos, D. Zacharia Vrsino authore.
VIII. Theses D. Zach. Vrsini de praecipuis aliquot doctrinae Christianae capitibus.

page.notes: The "ae" in "praedestinatione" and "cæna" is read from a slightly blurred scan; the ligature forms are kept as printed. "Orthodoxos" is a slightly blurred reading and may be "Orthedoxos" in print. The faint lettering at the top and bottom of the page is show-through from the other side and is not transcribed.
